Hi Kenta — thanks for sending these over. I reviewed the files quickly; a few items to address so we can move to PO: 

1) COI endorsement wording:
- Our procurement/legal standard requires the COI to include the following endorsement in the "Certificate Holder" or endorsement block: 
  "Redwood Inference, its affiliates and subsidiaries, and their officers, directors and employees are named as additional insured with respect to Commercial General Liability and Products/Completed Operations."
- The version you sent documents the limits but does not include the explicit additional-insured wording. Can your broker add that endorsement and re-issue the COI?

2) Named insured vs subcontractors:
- If AuraServ intends to use subcontractors in delivery, the endorsement must either name them or include broad subcontractor coverage language. Please confirm.

3) Tax cert: thank you — finance will advise on tax form equivalency for our records.

I have looped in Logan (procurement) and Priyom (legal) for vendor number, PO timing, and any contractual language we should flag. Once we have the endorsed COI and confirmation on subcontractors, procurement can open the PO flow. Let me know if you want a short call with procurement to speed this up.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Vendor Risk & Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference
